functions.query: SELECT name, is_aggregate, case_insensitive, alias_to, introduced_in, deterministic, higher_order FROM system.functions ORDER BY name FORMAT TSVWithNames

table-functions.query: SELECT name, allow_readonly, description FROM system.table_functions ORDER BY name FORMAT TSVWithNames

keywords.query: SELECT keyword AS word, 'UNKNOWN' AS category, '' AS token FROM system.keywords ORDER BY keyword FORMAT TSVWithNames

types.query: SELECT name, case_insensitive, alias_to, description, syntax, introduced_in FROM system.data_type_families ORDER BY name FORMAT TSVWithNames

settings.query: SELECT name, type, default, alias_for, is_obsolete, tier, description FROM system.settings WHERE name IN ('enable_streaming_queries','enable_nullable_tuple_type','allow_nullable_tuple_in_extracted_subcolumns','allow_experimental_lateral_join','sql_compatible_division_for_integers','enable_trino_dialect','enable_json_ast_dialect','allow_experimental_eval_table_function','enable_ipcrypt','enable_xgboost','enable_elasticsearch','enable_analyzer','allow_experimental_analyzer','allow_experimental_window_view','compatibility','session_timezone','timezone','join_default_strictness','group_by_use_nulls','validate_group_by_all_key_types','max_bytes_before_external_distinct','max_bytes_ratio_before_external_distinct','max_bytes_before_external_set','run_query_in_background','query_cache_for_subqueries','ai_function_text_default_credentials','ai_function_embedding_default_credentials','enable_logsql_dialect','enable_pco_codec','enable_alp_codec','allow_experimental_codecs') ORDER BY name FORMAT TSVWithNames

documentation.query: SELECT name, toString(type) AS type, source, description FROM system.documentation WHERE name IN ('LIMIT','FROM','JOIN','CREATE TOKEN','CREATE HANDLER','QBit','MultiPoint','Tuple','year','arrayTopK','arrayBottomK','MVTEncode','groupFormat','randomHadamardTransform','xxHash64Spark','dictGetRoot','gini','mergedJSONPatch','notHas','parseQueryToJSON','formatQueryFromJSON','arrayFlattenedLength','parseISO8601Duration','hierarchicalKMeans','assignCentroid','arrayMinIndex','arrayMaxIndex','arrayRemoveAt','mapRemove','mapEntries','mapContainsKeyValue','obfuscate','elasticsearch','predictXGBoost','normalizedQueryHashUnordered') ORDER BY type, name FORMAT JSONEachRow

statements.query: SELECT name, syntax, description, parent_name, related FROM system.statements ORDER BY name FORMAT JSONEachRow
